notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[b]Update Notes:[/b]

M60 was added. (Let the bullet rain begin!)

The map of Hallowen Italy has been added.

Inventory and Market Buttons have been added.
(We are working on these options are not active yet.)

Friends button added.
(We are working on these options are not active yet.)


[b]Fixed:[/b]

Fixed UI errors in Main Menu.
Resolution errors in High FPS and Low settings have been fixed.
Pixel errors in lighting have been fixed.
Player running speed has been adjusted from 8.7 to 9.
Golden Badge Chance Raised.

notes.title: Hotfix + New Features !
notes.notes:
[b]A Few Fix:[/b]

Fixed a few bugs on the Italy map.
Sound settings have been adjusted and new sounds have been added on the Italy map.
The sound in the Main Menu was automatically muted temporarily. (Working on the sound adjustment system)
The animation error on the weapon named AS-VAL has been fixed.
Due to a problem in the Refresh button, the rooms were not visible, now the refresh button works automatically.
Score and Menu table now opens when pressing "ESC" and "Tab".
Performance update has been made.

[b]New Feature:[/b]

FFA Mode Added.
Online Chat Added.
Fast running added.
(Players can now run with the Shift key.)

[b]Upcoming Updates Soon:[/b]

Hit Detector will be added.
A sniper grade weapon will be added.
New maps are on the way!
Language system will be added.

(The game will always be up to date. Problems will be detected and resolved on a daily basis.
[u][b]We will always make updates by considering the requests of our players.[/b][/u])

notes.title: We're Working On The First Day Update
notes.notes:
We're working on the First day update.

If the sound of the game is loud, you can lower it from your computer's volume setting.
We'll take care of the game's sound problem by tomorrow.

In-game items fall into your inventory with a certain chance rate.

If you cannot find the server when you enter the game, you have to press the refresh button.
So you can see if there are any open servers.

We will try to improve and fix bugs as much as we can.
If you have any problems, you can write under this post.

Thanks.
